description: Staffpass remote MCP — AI employee control plane for Grok Bot. Fail-closed Gateway: whoami, invoke (purpose+jobId), approval status poll, health. Confirm/send/order require human approval with explicit approvalId/statusToken/pollUrl return pipe.
